sourceDate.text: 太祖以遙輦氏於越受禪
太祖以遙輦氏於越受禪

label.en: Imperial Maternal Uncle Separate Division changgun

translationRepairs: Taizu took the throne when the Yaolian yuyue yielded power.
Taizu, as yuyue of the Yaolian clan, received the abdication.

In s0085, 以遙輦氏於越受禪 marks the capacity in which Taizu received abdication (as Yaolian yuyue), matching the Great Yuyue Office context; the idiomatic wrongly treats a separate Yaolian yuyue as the one who yielded.
Taizu received the abdication from the Yaolian yuyue.
Taizu, as the Yaolian clan's yuyue, received the abdication.
The same 以…受禪 construction in s0085 means Taizu received abdication as the Yaolian clan's yuyue; reading 遙輦氏於越 as the giver is a misparse of 以.
The empress dowager, senior consort, and empress each had account-registered bureaus.
The empress dowager and senior consort accounts each had account-registered bureaus.
s0165 names only 皇太后、皇太妃帳; the idiomatic invents a third empress account not in the Chinese.
The Empress Dowager's account, the Senior Imperial Consort's account, and the Empress's account each had account-registered bureaus.
The Empress Dowager's account and the Senior Imperial Consort's account each had account-registered bureaus.
The literal likewise adds an Empress's account; the source lists only the Empress Dowager's and Senior Imperial Consort's accounts.
Suzu's eldest Zhi Yan's line sat in the Five Courts Office; uncle Ge La, younger brother Zhi Li, and Yi's second son Tie La and younger brother Gu Zhi in the Six Courts Office.
Suzu's eldest son Zhi Yan's line sat in the Five Courts Office; third son Ge La, youngest son Zhi Li, and Yi Zu's second son Tie La and youngest son Gu Zhi were in the Six Courts Office.
In s0186, 叔子 and 季子 are birth-order labels for Suzu's and Yi Zu's sons (parallel to 長子/仲子), not 'uncle' or 'younger brother'; the proposed kinship terms restore that sequence and name 懿祖 as Yi Zu.

The eldest son Zhi Yan's line of Ancestor Suzu was in the Five Courts Office; uncle Ge La, younger brother Zhi Li, and Ancestor Yi's second son Tie La and younger brother Gu Zhi were all in the Six Courts Office.

The eldest son Zhi Yan's line of Ancestor Suzu was in the Five Courts Office; third son Ge La, youngest son Zhi Li, and Ancestor Yi's second son Tie La and youngest son Gu Zhi were all in the Six Courts Office.
The literal of s0186 makes the same kinship error; third son / youngest son correctly render 叔子 and 季子 under Suzu and Yi Zu.
Xuanzu's elder brother Malu left no heirs; second son Yan Mu's line is the Senior Father's House;
Xuanzu's eldest son Malu left no heirs; second son Yan Mu's line is the Senior Father's House;
玄祖伯子麻鲁 pairs with 次子岩木 in s0188; 伯子 is Xuanzu's eldest son, so 'elder brother' reverses the genealogy.
Ancestor Xuanzu's elder brother Malu had no heirs; the second son Yan Mu's descendants are the Senior Father's House;
Ancestor Xuanzu's eldest son Malu had no heirs; the second son Yan Mu's descendants are the Senior Father's House;
The literal likewise misreads 伯子 as elder brother; eldest son matches the birth-order series continued by 次子、叔子、季子.
Uncle Shi Lu formed the Middle Father's House;
The third son Shi Lu formed the Middle Father's House;
s0189 叔子釋魯 continues Xuanzu's sons after 伯子/次子 in s0188; 'uncle' invents a wrong kinship link.
Uncle Shi Lu is called the Middle Father's House;
The third son Shi Lu is called the Middle Father's House;
The literal of s0189 makes the same error; third son correctly renders 叔子 in this genealogical sequence.
s0297 is 某宮提轄司; 提轄 romanizes as tixia, and tirua is an unsupported corruption.
Senior Imperial Consort Xiaowen Dunmu Palace and Wenzhong Princely Establishment
Xiaowen Imperial Younger Brother Dunmu Palace and Wenzhong Princely Establishment
孝文皇太弟 is Xiaowen Imperial Younger Brother (皇太弟), not Senior Imperial Consort (皇太妃); the proposed title matches the Chinese.
Senior Imperial Consort Xiaowen Dunmu Palace; Wenzhong Princely Establishment
Xiaowen Imperial Younger Brother Dunmu Palace; Wenzhong Princely Establishment
The literal of s0315 repeats the same 皇太弟→Senior Imperial Consort error; Xiaowen Imperial Younger Brother restores the correct title.
